summary: Phase 8A Payroll (Bonus/Gratuity/Incentive/Advance/Loan compute, Advance/Loan CRUD, Payslip PDF, Monthly Payroll Runs, FnF) fully verified. 48 unit/pure-calc tests + 19 new HTTP integration tests = 67/67 passing. Calculation accuracy matches spec exactly: Bonus 6997.20, Gratuity 230769.23, Loan EMI 4614.49, FnF net 223384.62. Frontend /payroll-runs admin page loads, sidebar link present, create-run/freeze/mark-paid/delete workflow works; skipped-employees list rendered when template missing.

minor.issue: Update does NOT re-compute schedule even when amount/tenure/rate changes. After an update the persisted schedule becomes stale. Low-impact for MVP.
No uniqueness check on (month, year). Admin can create unlimited duplicate runs for the same period (observed 3 Jan/Feb/Apr 2026 runs). Consider de-dup or warn.
When admin calls it with no employee_id, endpoint proceeds with employee_id=None and emp={}; the PDF is still produced but with blank employee fields. Suggest 400 validation.

issues: Each run card shows '0 employees' because seeded employees have no salary template assignment — cosmetic, but user may be confused; consider empty-state copy '0 employees (all skipped — see details)'.

passed_tests: POST /api/advances CRUD: create returns schedule with monthly_emi; list & delete work
POST /api/loans CRUD: create attaches schedule (EMI 4614.49); delete works
POST /api/payslip/generate (admin, self): returns application/pdf with %PDF header

POST /api/payroll/runs: creates draft run, lists skipped employees when no template; GET /api/payroll/runs lists it; PUT freeze → 200; DELETE on frozen → 400; PUT mark-paid → 200; DELETE on fresh draft → 200
POST /api/fnf/compute: wage=50000, yrs=7, leave=15, unpaid=10, notice=5, reimb=3000, loans=20000 → net_fnf=223384.62 (matches spec exactly)
Regression: all Phase-7 Salary Compute & CRUD tests (19) still passing
Regression: 29 pure-function payroll_calc tests still passing
Frontend: [data-testid=create-payroll-run] opens dialog with [data-testid=confirm-create-run]; clicking creates run and list shows run cards
Frontend: clicking a draft run card reveals [data-testid=freeze-run] button; skipped employees listed
action_items: (Minor) Re-compute schedule inside PUT /api/advances/{id} & /api/loans/{id} when financial fields change.
(Minor) De-duplicate (month, year) payroll runs or emit warning.
(Minor) Validate employee_id on POST /api/payslip/generate — currently produces blank-employee PDF when id missing.
(Cosmetic, carried over from iter 8) React a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent' still logged in dev console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now >2820 lines — strongly recommend splitting Phase-8 code into backend/modules/payroll_runs.py, payslip.py, fnf.py for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
_build_payslip_pdf is defined inline in server.py (~126 lines); move to backend/payslip_pdf.py with the reportlab imports at module scope instead of inside the function.

Payroll Run POST computes salary for up to 5000 employees sequentially inside a single request; for orgs >100 employees this will time-out on the default Uvicorn worker. Consider a background task (BackgroundTasks / Celery) returning a job_id, then polling.

FnF uses 'basic/26' per-day even though user supplies 'last_drawn_basic'; document clearly that the input should be Basic+DA (the gratuity wage), not full CTC — mismatched input will silently skew both leave_encashment and notice_recovery.

Advance & Loan CRUD have no authorization check on GET for a specific employee_id — any authenticated admin can list anyone's advances (intended); however the employee-scoped branch only triggers when employee_id query param is missing. An employee could pass employee_id=<other_user> and bypass the scope filter. Add: if current_user.role != ADMIN and employee_id and employee_id != current_user.id: 403.
No max-cap on FnF: negative net_fnf (recoverable) is allowed without flag; status='recoverable' set but endpoint still returns 200 — OK, but downstream consumers should not treat it as a payable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login → sidebar → /payroll-runs → create → run card → freeze button all working)

seed_data_creation: test_phase8a_apis.py creates TEST_-prefixed advances/loans and deletes them in-test. Payroll runs created during test remain (one extra draft deleted; one frozen-then-paid retained — no cleanup for status!=draft since endpoint blocks deletion).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8A fully verified against user's expected sample values (user quoted them in agent_to_agent_context_note). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_phase8a_apis.py as HTTP regression for payroll endpoints. Only 3 non-blocking minor backend issues flagged (schedule recompute on PUT, duplicate runs, null employee_id on payslip). For UI: to exercise the payslip-download button, first assign a salary template to an employee (POST /api/salary-assignments), then create a payroll run — the run's line_items will populate and the [data-testid=payslip-<empId>] button will render.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — all requested features are verified working exactly to spec. The minor findings above are code-quality/defensive-programming suggestions, not active bugs.
